entries.title: Proverbs 16:1
segments: ¶The purposes of the heart are of man, but the answer of the tongue is from Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:2
segments: ¶All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Jehovah weigheth the spirits.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:3
segments: ¶Commit thy works unto Jehovah, and thy thoughts shall be established.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:4
segments: ¶Jehovah hath wrought everything on his own account, yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:5
segments: ¶Every proud heart is an abomination to Jehovah: hand for hand, he shall not be held innocent.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:6
segments: ¶By loving-kindness and truth iniquity is atoned for; and by the fear of Jehovah [men] depart from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:7
segments: ¶When a man's ways please Jehovah, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:8
segments: ¶Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues without right.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:9
segments: ¶The heart of man deviseth his way, but Jehovah directeth his steps.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:10
segments: ¶An oracle is on the lips of the king: his mouth will not err in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:11
segments: ¶The just balance and scales are Jehovah's; all the weights of the bag are his work.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:12
segments: ¶It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness; for the throne is established by righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:13
segments: ¶Righteous lips are the delight of kings, and they love him that speaketh aright.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:14
segments: ¶The fury of a king is [as] messengers of death; but a wise man will pacify it.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:15
segments: In the light of the king's countenance is life, and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:16
segments: ¶How much better is it to get wisdom than fine gold, and the getting of intelligence to be preferred to silver!

entries.title: Proverbs 16:17
segments: ¶The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that taketh heed to his way keepeth his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:18
segments: ¶Pride [goeth] before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:19
segments: ¶Better is it to be of a humble spirit with the meek, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:20
segments: ¶He that giveth heed to the word shall find good; and whoso confideth in Jehovah, happy is he.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:21
segments: ¶The wise in heart is called intelligent, and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:22
segments: ¶Wisdom is a fountain of life for him that hath it; but the instruction of fools is folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:23
segments: ¶The heart of the wise maketh his mouth intelligent, and upon his lips increaseth learning.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:24
segments: ¶Pleasant words are [as] a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health for the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:25
segments: ¶There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof is the ways of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:26
segments: ¶The appetite of the labourer laboureth for him, for his mouth urgeth him on.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:27
segments: ¶A man of Belial diggeth up evil, and on his lips there is as a scorching fire.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:28
segments: A false man soweth contention; and a talebearer separateth very friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:29
segments: ¶A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into a way that is not good.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:30
segments: He that shutteth his eyes, [it is] to devise froward things; biting his lips, he bringeth evil to pass.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:31
segments: ¶The hoary head is a crown of glory, [if] it is found in the way of righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:32
segments: ¶He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty, and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:33
segments: ¶The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole decision is of Jehovah.
